title: Kissed Roasted Mediterranean Chicken Skillet
description: A roasted, velvety Mediterranean dish featuring chicken, vegetables, and a creamy coconut sauce, perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the chicken with salt and black pepper.
Dredge the chicken in 00 flour, shaking off excess.
Heat olive oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the chopped onion, garlic, and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in coconut cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
